about.title: About me
about.experience: I am an AI Engineering & Innovation Lead with over {yearsDiff} years of commercial software development experience. I design and build AI systems - agents, automations and applications that teams use in their daily work.

work.description: On a daily basis, I work at <instreamly>inStreamly</instreamly>, where I work on transforming the company into an AI-first organization - rebuilding processes and leading <aiImplementation>AI implementation</aiImplementation> across the company. One of the projects is an AI-first sales engine: a shared database of clients, offers and correspondence, plus agents that maintain it and pick up signals for reaching out. Earlier, I created <teamSupport>solutions that save teams time</teamSupport>, including a support agent that correctly handled 95.8% of 932 tickets in Q2 2026. In parallel, part-time at <aihero>AI Hero</aihero>, I own the internal and product areas of the Development department, including the AI platform for the company's clients.

brands.description: I have also worked on projects for brands such as <samsung>Samsung</samsung> and <pkobp>PKO Bank Polski</pkobp>. Until August 2025, I ran my own business <mwebs>mwebs</mwebs>, where I was responsible for the entire process - from first contact with a client to implementation and technical support.

values.description: In my work, I take <dri>full responsibility (DRI)</dri> for the tasks entrusted to me, treating each project as if it were my own. I value <feedback>honest and constructive feedback (Feedback)</feedback> and believe that <nvc>kindness and mutual respect (NVC)</nvc> are key to team success.
